fields.System.Title: INB-404 — Report supplier delivery performance
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a buyer, I want to see which suppliers deliver late, short, or damaged, so that I
can hold them to account with evidence.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a date range, then I get on-time rate, short-delivery rate, over-delivery rate,
  • and damage rate per supplier.
  • - Given the report, then it also shows how often deliveries arrived with no ASN.
  • - Given the report, then it is built from a read model refreshed daily, not a live query
  • over all history.
  • - Given a supplier, then I can drill into the individual receipts behind their figures.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound |
| Tables | supplier performance projection, receipt, discrepancy |
| Risks | Projection drift ([doc 08 §10](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
